column1: # ImageGen: one text-free square illustration per word.
# Style: warm vintage gouache, paper grain, earthy ochre, moss, teal and brick red.
# Full bleed. No text, letters, words, numbers, typography, writing on props or watermarks.

column2: An inviting path winds between slender leafy trees, with light filtering through leaves, low wildflowers and a sunny clearing beyond.
Close-up of a child's open palm containing several sunflower and bean seeds, a few tiny seeds lying on fresh garden soil below, a sprouting seedling nearby for context.
Several visibly different wild grasses, ferns and uncultivated flowers growing freely among stones along a woodland path, no garden beds.
Three small distinct gray-brown mice together under a wooden table, with round ears and slender tails, all three clearly visible.
View diagonally across a school courtyard where students stand neatly in two straight parallel queues outside a classroom.
A tiny wild brown field mouse on hind legs among tall golden field grasses and ripe seed heads, large round ears and a long tail.

A caring school nurse helps two unwell students in a bright clinic, one coughing into an elbow and another having their temperature checked. Add subtle pictorial magnified germ shapes at the side, no graphic detail.
A red ball has just fallen from the bank into a small river, caught at the moment it strikes the water in a clear circular splash; two children watch safely from the bank.
A turbulent stream racing downhill over dark rocks, foamy white rapids clearly flowing diagonally across the image, natural vegetation at the edges.
A worried child relaxes their shoulders and exhales with visible soft breath in cold morning air after safely finding their little dog. Open relaxed posture and gentle relief.
A curious schoolchild kneels and tilts their head inquisitively, peering closely into a slightly open little wooden box, eyes wide with interest.
A complete international chess set arranged on a wooden table, clearly visible checkered chessboard with matching dark and light pieces and a small fitted storage box, viewed from above at an angle.
Close-up of five distinct carved international chess pieces, including an unmistakable horse-shaped knight, a castle-shaped rook and pawn, with a soft blurred checkered board behind.

Three sequential small scenes within one cohesive illustration, the same girl continuing to practice violin through morning, afternoon and evening shown by changing window light and her repeating playing posture. No panel labels.

An older student looks at a small framed memory of their younger self and sister repeatedly walking the familiar path to school. Strong contrast between present quiet foreground and warm recollection of the past, no text.
A sensitive portrait of a child hearing sad news, with one clearly visible translucent tear rolling down each cheek, soft empathetic lighting, no distressing details.
A warmly lit room filled with laughter, a group of classmates laughing together around a table, visual focus on the shared joyful feeling permeating the room.
Close-up of a woven basket completely full of red and green apples, fruit heaped to the rim and one resting beside the basket.
A small fire suddenly flares from an unattended kitchen pan, seen at a safe distance, two characters stepping back in surprise, no injury, clear sudden-event storytelling.
A kind classmate sits beside a sad child and listens, offers a tissue and rests a comforting hand on their shoulder, compassionate facial expressions.
A few visitors with small day bags quietly explore a museum gallery, looking at framed landscape paintings and a sculpture, with completely blank walls and no visible signage or exhibit captions.
Students taking practical action together to clean a park, one collecting litter with a grabber, another holding the bag, a third sorting empty bottles. Clear active poses.
A child's hand adds one more bright red apple to a plate already holding three apples, a small visual contrast between the single apple being added and the existing group.
One pupil in a bright red coat among a crowd wearing muted blues and sage, with the pupil clearly visible while naturally part of the group.
A willing pupil steps forward with a warm smile and reaches to help a classmate carry a heavy box of books, generous voluntary body language.

A student works through several chores, with a simple pictorial checklist showing only little icons for watering a plant, stacking books and putting shoes away, beside real task items. No text or numerals anywhere.
A student arrives through the open door of a classroom meeting, other classmates turn and smile in welcome; clear entrance and arrival.
A child returns a small found wallet to its relieved owner while another classmate helps someone who dropped their books, illustrating honesty and kindness as shared values.
A school library scene with students following quiet and tidy behavior, and three small purely pictorial icons for quiet, returning a book, and putting a bag aside. No symbols resembling writing.
A person extends an open hand toward a friend for support, side view, accurate natural hand anatomy, focus on the gesture and friendly expression.
A shy student speaks in front of a small public audience in a community hall, faces turned toward them, clear contrast between one speaker and the audience.
A joyful runner crosses a plain finish ribbon after a school race, eyes bright and arms lifting, unmistakable relief and achievement. No writing on clothes, ribbon or bib.
A friendly adult sits clearly visible at the wheel in the cab of a large delivery truck, looking ahead, with the truck body recognizable. Truck entirely unmarked with no license plates or writing.
Three smiling young contest winners stand on a plain tiered awards podium with medals and a small trophy, classmates applaud. Podium has plain unmarked fronts and no numerals.

A simplified unlabeled country-shaped map with dotted routes crossing from far west to east and north to south, three tiny pictorial landmarks and a little traveling bus. Absolutely no map text, symbols for cities only.
A smiling young performer walks down steps at the side of a wooden theatre stage, warm stage lights and curtains visible behind, a few audience silhouettes in front.
Two joyful children jumping up and down with knees bent and feet clearly off the ground, subtle simple motion lines and shadows emphasize the vertical movement.
An adult has patiently taught a child how to swim, shown guiding their arm movement in a calm shallow pool while the child proudly practices; gentle safe learning scene.

A wooden school notice board on a corridor wall, with several pinned sheets displaying only colored geometric pictograms such as a small ball, book, and leaf. No readable marks, handwriting, letters, or numerals.
A new student with a backpack is welcomed into a circle of smiling classmates, a classmate moves aside to make room and invites them with a friendly gesture.
Students running relay on a school athletics field with a supervising coach
A PE teacher in a blue tracksuit demonstrates a stretch to children standing in a semicircle on a gym floor
An IT engineer with a laptop and a colleague checking network cables in a modern server room, screens face away
A friendly teacher helps a shy pupil and makes a playful expression, the nearby pupils smile and laugh
A judge in a black robe listens attentively from the bench in a courtroom, gavel and blank paperwork
A student works hard on a difficult geometry problem, brows furrowed and a blank notebook with simple unlettered shapes
A teacher introduces Chinese language and literature in a middle school classroom, students listen while holding books whose plain covers face the viewer

Square vintage gouache storybook illustration for a middle school vocabulary atlas. A young adult programmer at a workstation building a colorful simple game shown on the screen, screen shows only a geometric maze and a little pixel character, absolutely no code, letters, numbers, watermarks, signs, text or symbols that resemble writing. Warm cream, ochre and muted teal, clear focused composition.
